answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can trade, with the stake sized to the value it wants to move. A harbor registry then issues one credential per verified stake, so creating a thousand fake identities means funding a thousand separate stakes. The economics put the attacker on a narrow ledge: any proven fraud slashes the stake, so a Sybil farm pays full price for each identity and loses it all when caught.
